description: US rules for mailing prescription drugs from the official texts, section by section with citations: USPS Publication 52 section 453 (definitions, mailer responsibility, what may be mailed, packaging and marking) and DEA 21 CFR Part 1306 (who may prescribe and fill, Schedule II-V refills, labeling, online pharmacies, telemedicine). Filter by source or words in the text. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

section.description: Optional exact section number, e.g. 453.34 or 1306.12
